cards.imageAlt: 滑行道起飞排队航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the aircraft queue shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的航空器排队场景中看到什么？

cards.audioText: What can cause aircraft to queue on a taxiway before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起飞前在滑行道上排队等候？
cards.referenceText: Queues can result when departure demand exceeds runway or airspace capacity. Weather, flow-control restrictions, runway inspection, crossing traffic, deicing, equipment faults and wake-turbulence spacing can slow the sequence. Gate release may also be poorly matched to the actual departure rate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当离场需求超过跑道或空域容量时，可能形成排队。天气、流量控制限制、跑道检查、穿越跑道的交通、除冰、设备故障和尾流间隔都会减慢放行顺序。机位放行时机也可能与实际离场率不匹配。

cards.audioText: What risks can arise when aircraft wait on the ground for an extended period before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器在起飞前长时间停留在地面可能产生哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: Long queues consume fuel, extend duty and increase fatigue, passenger discomfort and the chance that takeoff data or weather becomes outdated. Close-spaced ground traffic can increase runway-incursion, jet-blast, overheating and communication risks. A technical or medical problem may also be harder to manage when access to a stand is limited.
cards.referenceTextZh: 长时间排队会消耗燃油、延长执勤，并增加疲劳、旅客不适，以及起飞数据或天气信息过期的风险。间距很小的地面交通会增加跑道侵入、喷流、设备过热和通信风险。停机位难以返回时，技术或医疗问题也可能更难处理。

cards.audioText: How can long ground queues before takeoff be managed or reduced?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何管理或减少起飞前的长时间地面排队？
cards.referenceText: Airports and ATC can meter departures, coordinate runway use and share accurate capacity and expected-delay information. Airlines can hold aircraft at the gate when practical, update schedules and sequence flights using collaborative decision-making. Crews should manage fuel and cabin conditions, update performance and communicate any limit before it becomes urgent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场和 ATC 可以调节离场流量、协调跑道使用，并共享准确的容量与预计延误信息。条件允许时，航空公司可让飞机留在机位等待，更新时刻，并通过协同决策安排航班顺序。机组应管理燃油和客舱条件、更新性能，并在任何限制变得紧迫前及时通报。
